text:
nora_csm: Heads-up  BeaconMed tokens/day dropped ~91% over 9 days. Renewal in 13 days. Champion left; procurement is asking for a competitor bakeoff. Need fast triage and retention playbook.

analytics-bot: Alert: customer=BeaconMed, metric=tokens_9d, change=-91%, seats=7->2, error_rate=0.6%->5.9%, recent_deploy=2026-03-13. Link: https://redwood.app/customers/beaconmed/health

alejandro_sales: I was on procurement thread  they got a latency/cost pitch from Nimbus. Procurement says "responses timed out". I'll lead commercial outreach. Any quick proof points we can send?

sophie_eng: Quick triage plan: (1) per-key activity last 14d, (2) error histogram, (3) recent routing/deploys. If we can get 1-2 failing request ids that speeds this up.

marta_ops: Billing note: saw admin seats drop on 2026-03-16 via SSO deprovision automation. Could explain lost champion access. Also top API key went inactive 2026-03-17.

analytics-bot: Query summary (last 7d): errors=502(59%), 429(24%), 401(17%). Peak 502s 2026-03-17 00:30-02:30 UTC. Top_key last active 2026-03-17.

nora_csm: Scheduling a 15-min emergency sync with their interim PM in 20m to collect failing ids and confirm key rotation or endpoint toggles.

alejandro_sales: Draft counter: 10-day dedicated microburst (3x baseline) + 1-hr tech pairing + post-trial report. Need finance approval if credit > $4k. Tagging @finance-bot.

sophie_eng: On the call now  PM gave two failing ids: req_20260317_g5 and req_20260318_k2. Sending to ops and engineering.

sophie_eng: Triage: req_20260317_g5 -> 502 (router OOM due to payload spike), req_20260318_k2 -> 401 (old key). Root cause: batch-size change during a rollout + partial key rotation + accidental routing to preview endpoint.

marta_ops: Immediate mitigations: restore admin seats, whitelist PM IP for pairing, temporarily bump per-key burst x3 for confirmed new key, and enable a server-side throttle for payloads >5k tokens with a clear error message.

alejandro_sales: I emailed the PM with the written offer (10-day microburst at 3x throughput, 1-hr pairing). Asked for acceptance within 24h.

finance-bot: Quick calc: estimated unilateral credit for 10-day microburst = ~$4.6k. Approval required from Finance manager; flagging for expedited review.

nora_csm: Onboarded PM on pairing session scheduled for tomorrow 11am PT. I'll update the account playbook and add renewal-risk tag.

(later) finance-bot: Approved unilateral credit up to $5k. Proceed with goodwill microburst.

analytics-bot: 6h snapshot: tokens/day recovered to ~80% baseline after quota bump and key reconciliation; error rate down to 1.0%. Recommend 48h monitor and schedule QBR to rebuild champion relationship.

sophie_eng: I'll keep telemetry watch and revert throttles only after stable telemetry for 48h.

alejandro_sales: Procurement paused Nimbus pilot pending our microburst. If we execute cleanly this should materially reduce churn risk.

nora_csm: Added owners and follow-ups in the playbook. Scheduling a 7-day check-in and QBR prep. Will update thread with acceptance confirmation and QBR date.
